title: Option H01 REF EXT transfer check
source: Keysight E4418B/E4419B Service Guide, Instrument Accuracy Test, Test Procedure 2, pp. 2-11 to 2-14 (E4418B Service.pdf PDF pp. 51-54)
rangeSource: E4418B Service Guide step 8, p. 2-12 (PDF p. 52): RANGE 100 mW, POLARITY NORMAL, FUNCTION STANDBY, REF SWITCH EXT, LINE OFF
calibrationSource: E4418B Service Guide steps 12-13, p. 2-13 (PDF p. 53): set the DC calibrator to 144.93 mV, then CAL the power meter
notes: Table 2-4 is linear in power up to 1 mW (144.93 mV) and NOT above it: 459.12 mV is 3.1623 mW (linear would be 458.31 mV) and 15.588 V is 100 mW (linear would be 14.493 V). Use the rows as data; never scale them.
The table's limits do not include the measurement uncertainty (the Service Guide's note under Table 2-4).

The 11683A's power cord is unplugged throughout because of the H01 ground loop; a power meter must stay connected (risk of mild shock from the chassis otherwise). The DC calibrator's Guard and LO must float.
